# Elffuss tools

> Small tools that run in the browser: remove the background of a photo, read the text of images and PDFs, detect objects, make depth maps, create images from a text, and make a video from a photo or from a text. Each runs its model in the browser with WebGPU or WebAssembly. What a tool downloads is its model, from a Hugging Face repository at a pinned revision, the first time and then kept in that browser, and the software that runs it, from the tool's own site. Files the user opens never leave the device.

## Tools

- [Audio](https://audio.elffuss.com/en/): Makes music, sound effects and speech from text, with a player, a history and WAV downloads. Model: MOSS-TTS-Nano by OpenMOSS (Apache-2.0). Model download: 717 MB, the first time; it is then kept in that browser.
- [Remove background](https://cutout.elffuss.com/en/): Keeps the person or the object and gives you a transparent PNG. Model: BEN2 by PramaLLC (MIT). Model download: 219 MB, the first time; it is then kept in that browser.
- [Depth map](https://depth.elffuss.com/en/): Works out what is near and what is far in a photo, with a colour map, a 3D view and PNG downloads. Model: Depth Anything V2 Small by depth-anything (Apache-2.0). Model download: 27 to 99 MB, the first time; it is then kept in that browser.
- [Detect objects](https://detect.elffuss.com/en/): Finds people, cars, animals and up to 80 kinds of objects, also with your camera. Model: RF-DETR Nano by Roboflow (Apache-2.0). Model download: 29 MB, the first time; it is then kept in that browser.
- [Create images](https://image.elffuss.com/en/): Creates images from a text, in your browser, with shapes, a seed to repeat them and PNG downloads. Model: SANA-Sprint 0.6B by NVlabs (Apache-2.0). Model download: 3172 MB, the first time; it is then kept in that browser.
- [Read text](https://ocr.elffuss.com/en/): Gets the text out of photos, scans and PDFs, even whole folders. Model: PP-OCRv6 by PaddlePaddle (Apache-2.0). Model download: 31 MB, the first time; it is then kept in that browser.
- [Photo to video](https://video.elffuss.com/en/): A photo becomes a video with a 3D camera move and a soundtrack, as MP4. Or make one from a text. Models: Depth Anything V2 Small by depth-anything (Apache-2.0) and MI-GAN by Picsart AI Research (MIT). Model download: 57 to 129 MB, the first time; it is then kept in that browser.
- [Every tool](https://tools.elffuss.com/en/): the catalog.

## Modules

- `@elffuss/ai/core`: the pieces the tools share (model store client, backend choice, pinned runtimes, model registry, errors with codes).
- `@elffuss/ai/remove-bg` and `@elffuss/ai/remove-bg/sizes`: the remove-bg task and the download size of each of its variants.
- `@elffuss/ai/depth` and `@elffuss/ai/depth/sizes`: the depth task and the download size of each of its variants.
- `@elffuss/ai/detect` and `@elffuss/ai/detect/sizes`: the detect task and the download size of each of its variants.
- `@elffuss/ai/ocr` and `@elffuss/ai/ocr/sizes`: the ocr task and the download size of each of its variants.
- `@elffuss/ai/audio` and `@elffuss/ai/audio/sizes`: the text-to-music, text-to-sfx and text-to-speech tasks and the download size of each of their variants.
- `@elffuss/ai/text-to-image` and `@elffuss/ai/text-to-image/sizes`: the text-to-image task and the download size of each of its variants.
- `@elffuss/ai/video` and `@elffuss/ai/video/sizes`: the  and image-to-video tasks and the download size of each of their variants.
- `@elffuss/ai/video-gen` and `@elffuss/ai/video-gen/sizes`: the  and text-to-video tasks and the download size of each of their variants.

## Notes

- The weights are not served by Elffuss: each tool names its model, author and licence on its page.
- Without the Elffuss model store (models.elffuss.com) a tool downloads nothing and says so.
